content:
State and federal security forces carried out a joint inspection at the Centro de Ejecución de Sanciones (CEDES) in Nuevo Laredo, Eleese Noticias reported October 28. The operation was conducted under the National Law of Criminal Enforcement, according to the report.

The inspection covered eight modules of the prison and was aimed at improving internal control and maintaining conditions that support social reintegration, the report said. Personnel from the Guardia Estatal, the Secretariat of National Defense (SEDENA) and the National Guard took part, in coordination with staff from the Department of Security and Custody.

The intervention ended with the preventive seizure of unregulated items, including electrical accessories, wiring, clothing, personal care products and glass containers, according to Eleese Noticias. Tamaulipas' Public Security Secretariat said the coordinated work, with respect for the human rights of people deprived of liberty, consolidates discipline, security and adherence to the law in the state's prisons.

Sources:

  • Eleese Noticias, "Efectúan autoridades inspección de seguridad en el CEDES de Nuevo Laredo," October 28, 2026
